# Yeah под управлением оркестратора Paseo — разбор и план работ

> **Статус документа: разбор, а не доказательство.** Он описывает, что
> проверено на 2026-11-16, и то, что осталось открытым. Он не добавляет ни
> одного claim'а в `spec.json` и не меняет ни одного решения `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`.
> Открытая работа по правилам репозитория живёт в одном месте —
> `docs/PLAN.md` §17; решение о том, вносить ли этот разбор туда, принимает
> владелец.
>
> Ревизия на начало работы: `032153b`. Дата: 2026-11-16.
>
> **Ревизия 2 (тот же день): выводы перепроверены на живом провайдере.**
> Ключ провайдера взят из окружения и в репозиторий не попадает; все живые
> прогоны — через настоящий gptel и настоящий MiniMax. Два вывода из
> первой редакции подтвердились, один уточнился, и появился новый, более
> серьёзный: **маршрут ACP по умолчанию выдаёт оркестратору ложный успех.**
> Подробности — §2.9; изменившиеся формулировки помечены «(живой прогон)».
>
> **Ревизия 3 (тот же день): Yeah подключён к Paseo плагином.**
> Плагин `yeah-provider` (вне репозитория Yeah, в `/home/az/Projects/PaseoPlugins/`)
> зарегистрировал провайдера `yeah`; живой агент в Paseo создан, ход идёт,
> разрешения доходят до интерфейса. Подключение вскрыло дефект провода, который
> ни один офлайн-канарь не ловил: клиент, проверяющий форму уведомлений, отвергал
> **все** `session/update` Yeah, и текст агента не доходил до таймлайна.
> Разбор и починка — §2.10; починка в ядре — волна 40.

## 1. Короткий вывод

**Интеграционная точка уже существует в обоих репозиториях, и ACP поверх
stdio в Yeah работает сегодня.** Я провёл настоящий обмен JSON-RPC с
сервером ACP из этого дерева: `initialize`, `session/new` и `session/prompt`
отвечают корректно, ответ на промпт приходит с `stopReason: "end_turn"`.
Paseo умеет подключать любого агента, который говорит ACP, — и делает это
двумя маршрутами: через `config.json` (`extends: "acp"`) и через плагин
(`runAcpProvider`).

Живой прогон (настоящий gptel, настоящий MiniMax, сокетный транспорт —
§2.9) подтвердил:Yeah умеет чинить код своими инструментами и работает по
проводу с клиентом, который отвечает на разрешения.

Чего не хватает — не «интеграция вообще», а пять конкретных вещей:

1. **Рабочий каталог сессии не применяется к инструментам.** Paseo передаёт
   `cwd` в `session/new`, Yeah его записывает в журнал — и больше нигде не
   использует. Инструменты (`read`, `edit`, `write`, `bash`) считают
   относительные пути от `default-directory` процесса Emacs, а не от
   каталога рабочей области. Это ломает всё, что делает агент в репозитории.
   **(живой прогон: подтверждено — относительный путь ушёл в рабочий
   каталог сервиса, а не в `cwd` сессии; §2.9)**
2. **Нет `session/set_mode`.** Переключатель режимов (Plan/Build) в UI Paseo
   не появится: ACP-метода нет, `-32601`.
3. **Отмена не вытесняет идущий промпт на stdio.** `session/cancel`
   читается только после того, как промпт завершился. Долгий ход модели
   нельзя прервать — а значит, нельзя и перебить агента. (На сокете отмена
   вытесняет; канарь `check-wire-cancel-preempts.el` перезапущен и зелёный.)
4. **Бэкенд модели не внедряется через окружение.** В `lib/` нет ни одной
   переменной `YEAH_*`; ключ и модель провайдера надо передавать через
   `--eval` или `yeah-service-init-file`, а у Paseo `command` — это
   фиксированный argv.
5. **Маршрут ACP по умолчанию выдаёт ложный успех.** Надзор за прогоном
   (`max-nudges`) по умолчанию равен нулю, поэтому модель, которая вместо
   действия описывает намерение («I'll create that file now.»), завершает
   прогон как `completed`, и клиент получает `stopReason: "end_turn"` —
   неотличимый от успеха. Ничего не сделано, разрешение не спросили,
   журнал не отличается от журнала удачного прогона. **(живой прогон:
   воспроизведено и исправлено включением надзора; §2.9)**

Ниже — проверка каждого пункта и порядок работ.

## 2. Что проверено на стороне Yeah

### 2.1 ACP поверх stdio работает

Команда запуска (ровно та, что использует собственный канарий
`tests/checks/check-wire-speaks-over-stdio.el`):

```sh
emacs -Q --batch -L <repo>/lib -l yeah-acp \
  --eval "(progn (setq yeah-data-home \"<dir>\") (yeah-acp-serve))"
```

Измеренный обмен (проверено запуском, Emacs 30.2):

```json
→ {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":1}}
← {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"protocolVersion":1,
    "agentInfo":{"name":"yeah","version":"0.1.0"},
    "agentCapabilities":{"loadSession":true,
      "promptCapabilities":{"image":false,"audio":false,"embeddedContext":false},
      "mcpCapabilities":{"http":false,"sse":false}}}}

→ {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"session/new",
   "params":{"cwd":"/home/az/Projects/yeah","mcpServers":[]}}
← {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"result":{"sessionId":"session-1-7734bc"}}

→ {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"session/prompt",
   "params":{"sessionId":"session-1-7734bc",
             "prompt":[{"type":"text","text":"hello"}]}}
← {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"session/update", … "sessionUpdate":"input_queued" …}
← {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"session/update", … "sessionUpdate":"input_taken" …}
← {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"session/update", … "sessionUpdate":"user_message_chunk" …}
← {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"session/update", … "sessionUpdate":"agent_message_chunk" …}
← {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"result":{"stopReason":"end_turn"}}
```

**Инициализация отвечает за 0.66 с.** У Paseo на этот обмен таймаут 10 с
(`packages/plugin/src/server/acp-internal/connection.ts:403`), так что запас
по времени есть; опасность была только теоретической.

### 2.2 Таблица методов ACP

Реализовано в `lib/yeah-acp.el` (диспетчер — `yeah-acp.el:658-680`):

| Метод | Состояние | Место |
|---|---|---|
| `initialize` | есть | `yeah-acp.el:222-236` |
| `session/new` | есть | `yeah-acp.el:385-392` |
| `session/load` | есть (нужен точный исходный `cwd`) | `yeah-acp.el:394-409` |
| `session/prompt` | есть, ответ асинхронный | `yeah-acp.el:448-470` |
| `session/cancel` | есть | `yeah-acp.el:472-481` |
| `session/steer` | есть | `yeah-acp.el:519` |
| `session/withdraw` | есть | `yeah-acp.el:535` |
| `session/recover` | есть | `yeah-acp.el:553` |
| `session/set_mode` | **нет** (`-32601`, проверено) | — |
| `session/set_model` | **нет** (`-32601`, проверено) | — |
| `fs/read_text_file`, `fs/write_text_file` | **нет** (`-32601`, проверено) | — |
| `authenticate` | **нет** (`-32601`, проверено) | — |

`session/set_model` для Paseo не нужен: он меняет модель через
`session/set_config_option` с `category: "model"`. `authenticate` не нужен
тем более: Paseo его не шлёт, а Yeah не объявляет `authMethods`.

### 2.3 Что уходит в `session/update`

Проецируется 8 видов (`yeah-acp.el:298-327`): `input_queued`,
`input_taken`, `input_recovered`, `input_withdrawn`, `user_message_chunk`,
`agent_message_chunk`, `tool_call`, `tool_call_update`.

**Не проецируется** (остаётся только в журнале): `finish`, `error`,
`unfinished`, `nudge`, `usage`, `todo*`, `compaction`, `tool-dropped`,
`spawn`/`child-start`/`child-end`. Оркестратор по проводу не увидит, что
прогон не завершился и почему, сколько токенов потрачено и что
запустился дочерний агент. Единственный источник правды — JSONL-журнал:

```text
<yeah-data-home>/yeah/projects/<sha256(file-truename(cwd))>/sessions/<sessionId>.jsonl
```

### 2.4 Разрешения

Yeah спрашивает по проводу через `session/request_permission`
(`yeah-acp.el:103-119`) с опциями:

```json
{"optionId":"allow-once","name":"Allow once","kind":"allow_once"}
{"optionId":"allow-always","name":"Allow always","kind":"allow_always"}
{"optionId":"reject-once","name":"Reject","kind":"reject_once"}
```

Это ровно та форма, которую понимает Paseo: `kind`, начинающееся с `allow`,
становится разрешением, всё прочее — отказом. Ответ приходит как
`{"outcome":{"outcome":"selected","optionId":"…"}}` или
`{"outcome":{"outcome":"cancelled"}}` — обе формы Yeah принимает.

`allow-always` помнится **только в рамках сессии** (`yeah-acp.el:606-617`).

**Живой прогон (2026-11-16):** восемь таких запросов дошли до клиента
(`write`, `bash`, `git_status`), ответ `allow-once` вернул управление
инструменту — цепочка «спросили → ответили → выполнили» работает по
проводу с настоящей моделью.

Аргументы инструмента едут в `rawInput` запроса, но **позиционным
списком**, а не структурой с ключами: `("answer.txt" "42" nil "")` для
`write`. Paseo читает оттуда `filePath`/`oldString`/`newString`
(`packages/plugin/src/server/acp-internal/connection.ts:1337-1341`) — там
таких ключей нет. Это подробности разрыва №6 (§4).

### 2.5 Инструменты и профили

Модель видит 22 инструмента (`yeah-tools-names`, проверено запуском):

```text
read glob grep edit write bash job-status job-read job-cancel
introspect buffer-read elisp-check diagnostics
todo_add todo_update todo_list
git_status git_diff git_commit
finish delegate delegate-result
```

Профиль `plan` запрещает `edit write bash job-cancel delegate`
(`lib/yeah-perm.el:95-115`), профиль `build` спрашивает по каждому из них.
Переключение профиля — событие журнала, но **не** ACP-метод.

### 2.6 Ограничения транспорта

* **stdio** (`yeah-acp-serve`, `yeah-acp.el:719-743`): один запрос за раз;
  после каждого запроса сервер крутит event loop до конца текущего хода
  (`yeah-wire-pump-until`), поэтому `session/cancel`, пришедший во время
  промпта, читается только после того, как промпт завершился. Это написано
  в докстринге и подтверждено чтением кода.

5. **Честный реестр живых доказательств.** Шесть живых проверок вынесены из карты
   и описаны в `docs/LIVE-EVIDENCE.md`: у них нет отрицательного контроля, поэтому
   зелёный вердикт карты о них не говорит ничего.

## 4. Где сессия ослабила дисциплину

1. **Четверть вызовов — ожидание, а не работа.** 178 `task_output` плюс около 40
   циклов `sleep`/`pgrep` наблюдали за прогоном `mathc`. Сессия получила
   напоминание системы «три подряд чтения одной фоновой задачи — прекратите опрос»
   — и всё равно продолжала опрашивать.
2. **Метод прогонялся многократно.** За сессию гейт/прогон запускался минимум пять
   раз (`v1`, `v2`, `v3`, «final», «timed final», «solo») — два-три часа на один
   и тот же результат. Причины: два нерабочих контроля и наивный чекер, который
   трактовал шаблон `sed` как регулярку, а не как литерал.
3. **Сессия закрылась без ответа.** Ошибка `A foreground turn is already active`
   оставила человека без вердикта, хотя работа была сделана и проверена.
4. **Ничего не зафиксировано в git.** 51 путь волны (40 изменённых, 11 новых) остались
   в рабочем дереве: `docs/REVIEW-2026-11-15.md`, `docs/LIVE-EVIDENCE.md`,

### P1. §16.6 — пиксельный smoke (1–2 дня)

**Сделано 2026-11-15:** снимки снимаются под Xvfb, критерий структурный
(журнал ↔ тот же буфер без интерфейса, журнал ↔ экран разрешения), контроль
кусается («the interface does not change the screen: 343 pixels differ»).
Проверка живёт вне карты метода: frame server в окружении метода нет, и
проверка без него — blocked, а не pass. Коммит `8fd666e`.

1. Поставить `xvfb-run` в профиль nix как **dev-only** зависимость (runtime-зависимость
   продукта не меняется); проверить, что Emacs 30.2 поднимается в этом frame server.
2. Снимать кадр журнала и экрана разрешения; хранить эталон в `tests/support/`;
   сравнение — по пикселям с допуском на шрифт либо по структурному признаку
   (строки, полосы, поля), чтобы тест не мигал от версии GTK.
3. Claim `the-interface-is-seen` (kind `acceptance`) с контролем, который ломает
   предмет так, чтобы канарейка упала, а не «стала нечитаемой».
4. Критерий приёмки: снимок снимается без участия человека; падение видно на
   специально испорченном снимке; проверка не требует ключа провайдера.

### P2. §16.7 — паритет, измеренный, а не заявленный (2–4 дня + решение владельца)

1. Пилот из трёх детерминированных задач набора: `read-answer`,
   `fix-failing-test`, `write-new-file`.
2. Прогнать их на Yeah с живым провайдером и на втором harness (opencode или pi —

;;; yeah-service.el --- a service Emacs running the Yeah harness -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
;;
;; Copyright (C) 2026  Petr Kosov
;;
;; This file is part of Yeah.
;;
;; Yeah is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify it under
;; the terms of the Apache License, Version 2.0.

;;; Commentary:
;;
;; The primary placement: a dedicated Emacs process runs the harness, so
;; the editing Emacs never shares a thread with a long turn.  This module
;; starts such a service, connects to it and stops it.  The service
;; serves ACP on a Unix-domain socket, or on a loopback TCP port when the
;; platform has no Unix socket; a cancel is handled while a prompt is still
;; running.
;;
;; The service runs the same Emacs as the person: the program is resolved
;; when the service starts, and the running binary is the fallback, so a
;; service starts on a machine where `emacs' is not on PATH.

;;; Code:

(require 'cl-lib)
(require 'yeah-client)
(require 'yeah-wire-socket)

(defgroup yeah-service nil
  "A service Emacs running the Yeah harness."
  :group 'yeah)

(defcustom yeah-service-emacs
  (or (executable-find "emacs")
      (and (file-executable-p (expand-file-name "~/.nix-profile/bin/emacs"))
           (expand-file-name "~/.nix-profile/bin/emacs"))
      invocation-name)
  "The Emacs program that runs the service."
  :type 'string
  :group 'yeah-service)

(defvar yeah-service--processes (make-hash-table :test 'equal)
  "Map a service name to its process.")

(defun yeah-service--emacs-program ()
  "Return the program that runs the service Emacs.

The service runs the SAME Emacs as the person: the binary that is
running now, when the platform can name it.  A program name that the
PATH does not carry would make the service impossible to start on a
machine where Emacs lives in a profile, so the running binary is the
fallback, and `EMACS' comes before it."
  (let ((configured (or yeah-service-emacs "emacs")))
    (cond
     ((or (file-name-absolute-p configured)
          (file-directory-p configured))
      configured)
     ((executable-find configured) (executable-find configured))
     ((and (getenv "EMACS") (file-executable-p (getenv "EMACS")))
      (getenv "EMACS"))
     ((file-executable-p "/proc/self/exe") "/proc/self/exe")
     ((file-executable-p (expand-file-name "~/.nix-profile/bin/emacs"))
      (expand-file-name "~/.nix-profile/bin/emacs"))
     (t configured))))

(defun yeah-service--socket-directory ()
  "Return the user-private directory the service sockets live in.
Anyone who can connect to the socket drives the agent with the person's
permissions, so the socket never sits in a world-writable /tmp: it goes
under XDG_RUNTIME_DIR when there is one, else under a directory of this
user with mode 0700."
  (let ((dir (if-let ((runtime (getenv "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR")))
                 (expand-file-name "yeah" runtime)
               (expand-file-name (format "yeah-%d" (user-uid))
                                 (or (getenv "TMPDIR") "/tmp")))))
    (unless (file-directory-p dir)
      (make-directory dir t)
      (set-file-modes dir #o700))
    dir))

;;;###autoload
(defun yeah-service-socket-path (name)
  "Return the socket path of the service NAME."
  (expand-file-name (format "yeah-service-%s.sock" name)
                    (yeah-service--socket-directory)))

(defun yeah-service--socket-path (name)
  "Return the socket path of the service NAME."
  (yeah-service-socket-path name))

(defun yeah-service--reserve-loopback-port ()
  "Return an unused loopback TCP port.
The probe binds the port briefly so the service child can bind the same
port without choosing a fixed, commonly occupied number."
  (let ((probe
         (make-network-process
          :name (format "yeah-service-port-%d" (random 1000000000))
          :server t
          :family 'ipv4
          :service 0
          :noquery t)))
    (unwind-protect
        (let ((port (process-contact probe :service)))
          (unless (and (integerp port) (> port 0) (<= port 65535))
            (signal 'user-error
                    (list "yeah-service-start: could not reserve a TCP port")))
          port)
      (when (process-live-p probe)
        (delete-process probe)))))

(defun yeah-service--write-port-file (socket port)
  "Publish PORT for SOCKET in the port file next to its socket path.
The file contains the port number only; it is not a credential."
  (let ((file (yeah-client-port-file socket)))
    (with-temp-file file
      (insert (number-to-string port)))
    (set-file-modes file #o600)
    file))

(defun yeah-service--lib-directory ()
  "Return the directory holding Yeah's Elisp modules."
  (file-name-directory (or (locate-library "yeah-acp") "yeah-acp.el")))

(defun yeah-service--rules-eval (rules)
  "Return the Elisp that installs RULES in the service.
RULES is a list of permission rule plists, as `yeah-perm-rule-make'
builds them; the service adds each of them to its own ruleset."
  (if (null rules)
      ""
    (format "(dolist (rule '%S) (yeah-perm-rules-add rule))" rules)))

;;;###autoload
(defun yeah-service-start (name &optional extra-eval data-home transport clean rules)
  "Start a service Emacs named NAME and return its process.
The service serves ACP on a Unix-domain socket, or on a loopback TCP port
when `yeah-client-network-family' selects `ipv4'.  In the TCP case the port
number is published in a `.port' file next to the socket path.  EXTRA-EVAL
is evaluated in the service before the server starts (to configure the
model backend); DATA-HOME is the service's data directory; TRANSPORT is a
form evaluating to the model transport of the service (nil uses the
default).  A service with the same name is not started twice.
CLEAN (the default) starts the service without the user's init; nil lets
the service inherit the user's configuration, including the gptel backend.
RULES is a list of permission rule plists: the standing permissions the
person grants the service, which is how a headless service may edit at
all."
  (let ((existing (gethash name yeah-service--processes)))
    (when (and existing (process-live-p existing))
      (signal 'user-error
              (list (format "yeah-service-start: %S is already running" name)))))
  (let* ((socket (yeah-service--socket-path name))
         (family (yeah-client-effective-network-family))
         (port (when (eq family 'ipv4)
                 (yeah-service--reserve-loopback-port)))
         (server-form
          (if (eq family 'local)
              (format "(yeah-acp-serve-socket %S %s)"
                      socket
                      (or transport "yeah-acp-default-transport"))
            (format "(yeah-acp-serve-socket %d %s nil 'ipv4)"
                    port
                    (or transport "yeah-acp-default-transport"))))
         (buffer (generate-new-buffer (format " *yeah service %s*" name)))
         (process
          (make-process
           :name (format "yeah-service-%s" name)
           :buffer buffer
           :command
           (append (list (yeah-service--emacs-program))
                   (if clean (list "-Q" "--batch") (list "--batch"))
                   (list "-L" (yeah-service--lib-directory)
                         "-l" "yeah-acp"
                         "--eval"
                         (format "(progn %s %s %s %s)"
                                 (or extra-eval "")
                                 (if data-home
                                     (format "(setq yeah-data-home %S)" data-home)
                                   "")
                                 (yeah-service--rules-eval rules)
                                 server-form)))
           :connection-type 'pipe
           :noquery t)))
    (when (eq family 'ipv4)
      (condition-case error
          (yeah-service--write-port-file socket port)
        (error
         (delete-process process)
         (signal (car error) (cdr error)))))
    (puthash name process yeah-service--processes)
    process))

;;;###autoload
(defun yeah-service-connect (name &optional timeout)
  "Connect to the service NAME and return the connection process.
Waits up to TIMEOUT seconds (default 10) for the socket to appear."
  (let ((socket (yeah-service-socket-path-internal name))
        (deadline (+ (float-time) (or timeout 10)))
        (connection nil))
    (while (and (null connection) (< (float-time) deadline))
      (setq connection (yeah-client--open-connection socket))
      (unless connection
        (accept-process-output nil 0.05)))
    connection))

(defun yeah-service-socket-path-internal (name)
  "Return the socket path of the service NAME."
  (yeah-service--socket-path name))

;;;###autoload
(defun yeah-service-stop (name)
  "Stop the service NAME and remove its socket."
  (when-let ((process (gethash name yeah-service--processes)))
    (when (process-live-p process)
      (delete-process process))
    (remhash name yeah-service--processes))
  (let ((socket (yeah-service--socket-path name)))
    (when (file-exists-p socket)
      (ignore-errors (delete-file socket)))
    (let ((port-file (yeah-client-port-file socket)))
      (when (file-exists-p port-file)
        (ignore-errors (delete-file port-file)))))
  t)

(provide 'yeah-service)
;;; yeah-service.el ends here

;;; yeah-wire-socket.el --- the socket transport for Yeah's wire protocols -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
;;
;; Copyright (C) 2026  Petr Kosov
;;
;; This file is part of Yeah.

;;; Commentary:
;;
;; The stdio transport of a wire protocol reads standard input with a
;; blocking read.  While that read blocks, the event loop of Emacs does
;; not run, so a notification that arrives while a request is being
;; answered is read only after the answer settled.  A reader thread does
;; not help: a thread blocked in `read-string' holds the interpreter lock,
;; and the whole Emacs stops until the read returns.
;;
;; A socket does help.  Emacs represents a connection as a process, so the
;; data of a connection arrives in a filter and the event loop keeps
;; running while the server waits.  A `session/cancel' that arrives during
;; a running prompt is therefore handled while the prompt is still
;; running, and two connections can be served at the same time.
;;
;; The transport is a local Unix socket by default; `ipv4' serves a
;; loopback TCP port instead.

;;; Code:

(require 'cl-lib)

(defgroup yeah-wire-socket nil
  "The socket transport of Yeah's wire protocols."
  :group 'yeah)

(defvar yeah-wire-socket--pending (make-hash-table :test 'eq)
  "The part of the last line received on each connection.")

(defun yeah-wire-socket--lines (connection chunk)
  "Return the complete lines in CHUNK for CONNECTION and keep the rest.
The incomplete tail of CONNECTION is kept for the next chunk."
  (let* ((pending (gethash connection yeah-wire-socket--pending ""))
         (combined (concat pending chunk))
         (parts (split-string combined "\n"))
         (complete (if (string-suffix-p "\n" combined)
                        parts
                      (butlast parts)))
         (tail (if (string-suffix-p "\n" combined)
                    ""
                  (car (last parts)))))
    (puthash connection tail yeah-wire-socket--pending)
    complete))

(defun yeah-wire-socket--respond (connection text)
  "Send TEXT to CONNECTION as one line."
  (when (process-live-p connection)
    (process-send-string connection (concat text "\n"))))

;;;###autoload
(defun yeah-wire-socket-server (service handler &optional family on-close)
  "Listen on the local socket SERVICE and serve connections with HANDLER.
FAMILY is `local' for a Unix socket and `ipv4' for a loopback TCP port.
HANDLER is called with (LINE RESPOND CONNECTION) for every complete line
of input; RESPOND takes one message and sends it back to that connection.
ON-CLOSE, when given, is called with CONNECTION after it closed: a
question asked of a dead connection must not hang the server.
Return the server process."
  (make-network-process
   :name "yeah-wire-socket"
   :server t
   :family (or family 'local)
   :service service
   :noquery t
   :sentinel
   (when on-close
     (lambda (connection _event)
       (when (memq (process-status connection) '(closed failed exit))
         (remhash connection yeah-wire-socket--pending)
         (funcall on-close connection))))
   :filter
   (lambda (connection chunk)
     (cond
      ((string= chunk "")
       (remhash connection yeah-wire-socket--pending))
      (t
       (dolist (line (yeah-wire-socket--lines connection chunk))
         (unless (string-blank-p line)
           (funcall handler line
                    (lambda (text) (yeah-wire-socket--respond connection text))
                    connection))))))))

;;;###autoload
(defun yeah-wire-socket-serve (service handler &optional family on-close)
  "Serve connections on SERVICE with HANDLER until the server stops.
FAMILY, HANDLER and ON-CLOSE mean what they mean in
`yeah-wire-socket-server'."
  (let ((server (yeah-wire-socket-server service handler family on-close)))
    (while (process-live-p server)
      (accept-process-output nil 0.05))
    server))

(provide 'yeah-wire-socket)
;;; yeah-wire-socket.el ends here

;;; yeah-acp.el --- ACP v1 agent over newline JSON-RPC -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
;;
;; Copyright (C) 2026  Petr Kosov
;;
;; This file is part of Yeah.

;;; Commentary:
;;
;; Agent-side ACP v1 over newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0.  Sessions are real
;; Yeah sessions; prompt responses are sent when the run reaches a terminal
;; state; session/cancel is a notification; journal events become
;; session/update notifications through `yeah-events-write-functions'.
;;
;; A session is driven by a controller: the same one the attached path uses.

;; so the wire can ask, steer, cancel, withdraw a pending input and recover

## 7. Решения, которые остаются за владельцем

Ни одно из них агент не решает сам (`docs/PLAN.md` §17.2):

* **Какой транспорт каноничен для оркестратора** — stdio (просто, но отмена
  не вытесняет) или сокет (вытесняет, но нужен отдельный жизненный цикл
  сервиса).
* **Маршрут подключения** — конфигурация (`extends: "acp"`, просто, есть
  Auto-Accept) или плагин (иконка, каталог моделей, трансформеры, но каждый
  вопрос о разрешении доходит до человека).
* **Ключ провайдера** — через окружение Paseo (`env` провайдера) или через
  файл инициализации сервиса.
* **Надзор за прогоном по умолчанию.** `yeah-turn-default-max-nudges` = 0
  оставляет маршрут ACP без надзора, и оркестратор получает ложный
  `end_turn` (§2.9.2). Менять ли это умолчание для всех прогонов или
  включать надзор только в маршруте ACP — решение владельца: первое
  меняет поведение интерактивной работы, второе оставляет его как есть.
* **Секреты в журнале** — `gptel` может писать usage в журнал; ключ туда
  попадать не должен, и это надо проверить отдельно.
* **Право Yeah на личные буферы человека** — уже стоит в §17.2 и не меняется

### 18.2 Wave 42 — the server does not outlive the agent, and it does not spin

**The defect.**  Two defects of one life cycle.  The process of the ACP
server outlives the agent: a client that keeps the pipe of the server open
after the last turn leaves an Emacs process behind, and nothing closes it.
And some of those processes burn half a core in a tight loop of userspace:
one of them was measured with 1,921,354 involuntary context switches and six
voluntary ones — it never slept — at 25–60 % of a core.

**What is known and what is not.**  The read loop of the server is not the
cause: an idle server costs no CPU and leaves cleanly when its input ends,
and a server that waits for a turn the model never answers costs about four
per cent of a core.  The spin is therefore on the path of the live request of
the provider, and the loop itself is not localized yet: `ptrace` and `strace`
are not available in this environment ("Operation not permitted"), so the
localization has to be done by measurement — the ticks of `/proc/<pid>/stat`,
not the percentage of the CPU that `top` prints.

**What changes.**
1. *The life cycle.*  The server has a way to end that does not depend on the
   client closing the pipe: the session ends, and the process exits.  The
   plugin of Paseo (`yeah-provider`, outside this repository) closes the pipe
   of the server when the session of the agent is over; the kernel side gives
   it a way to say so.
2. *The spin.*  The loop on the path of the live request is localized by
   instrumentation — a counter of the iterations of the pump and of the
   request of the provider — measured the way the defect itself was measured.
   The loop that spins is then removed, and the bound becomes a check.

**The claims.**
- `the-server-exits-when-the-session-is-over` — the process of the server is
  gone after the session ends, even when the client keeps the pipe open
  (the control keeps the pipe open and ends the session: the check must
  fail).
- `the-server-does-not-spin-when-the-provider-is-silent` — a server whose
  provider went silent costs less than one per cent of a core over ten
  seconds (the control brings the busy loop back: the measured ticks must
  exceed the bound).

**The exit criteria.**
1. A server left behind by a finished session is gone within ten seconds.
2. The ticks of a silent server stay under the bound in ten consecutive
   measurements.
3. The live check of the plugin leaves no process behind.

**The estimate.**  One to two days.  **What this wave does not fix.**  A
transport that dies with "Curl failed with exit code 28" is the provider's
death, not the harness's.

### 18.3 Wave 43 — the surface of ACP that an orchestrator needs

**The defect.**  The integration with Paseo found four gaps of the surface,
and all of them point the same way: an orchestrator cannot put the agent
where the work is, cannot change what the agent may do, and cannot read what
the agent did.

1. The working directory of a session — the `cwd` of `session/new` — is
   recorded in the journal and in the frozen input of the run, but the tools
   do not read it: a relative path of a tool is counted from the directory of
   the Emacs process and not from the directory of the session.  In the live

The defect, as the plan names it:

- The process of the ACP server outlives the agent: a client that keeps the pipe of the server open after the last turn leaves an Emacs process behind, and nothing closes it. This half of the wave is about that life cycle. (The second half — a server that spins when the provider is silent — is NOT this task; do not register that claim and do not try to localize the spin here.)

The claim of this half, as the plan names it:

- `the-server-exits-when-the-session-is-over` — the process of the server is gone after the session ends, even when the client keeps the pipe open. The control must break the subject, and the check must then fail by its own assertion: the control keeps the client sitting on an open pipe and takes out the way the server ends when its session is over, so the server survives and the check catches it.

The exit criterion of this half: a server left behind by a finished session is gone within ten seconds.

What to do:

1. Find out how the server process is started and how it is ended today. Do not guess: start real servers with the tools you have, look at the processes, and name the places you find (file and line). The places to look first are lib/yeah-service.el, lib/yeah-wire-socket.el, lib/yeah-acp.el and lib/yeah-emacs.el, but the truth is where it is.
2. Implement the way for the server to end that does not depend on the client closing the pipe: the session ends, and the process exits.
3. Write an end-to-end check `tests/checks/check-the-server-exits-when-the-session-is-over.el` that starts a real server process, ends the session while the client keeps the pipe open, and asserts that the process is gone within ten seconds. The check must decide its verdict by construction: the same input gives the same verdict every time. Look at how the existing checks of this repository are written and at how the claims declare their controls (spec.json) — a control of a claim is a command that the method applies to a copy of the tree, and yours must break the subject.
4. Register the claim in spec.json with that control, and prove the control bites: apply the control to a copy of the tree and show that your check fails with the exit code 1 and with its own words.

Say plainly what you did not prove.
6. Verify what you changed: `./scripts/dev byte-compile-all`, `./scripts/dev ert tests/unit/*.el`, and your new check file. Do not run `./scripts/dev run` and do not run the whole suite `./scripts/dev check tests/checks/*`.

One rule about the observation of this run: the journal of the run lives under `sessions/` in this repository. Never delete it and never delete anything else to make a check pass. ;;; yeah-acp-vocabulary.el --- the vocabulary the ACP sides of Yeah share -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
;;
;; Copyright (C) 2026  Petr Kosov
;;
;; This file is part of Yeah.

;;; Commentary:
;;
;; The ACP server of Yeah and the ACP client of Yeah speak one protocol: the
;; version of that protocol and the name of Yeah's own extension are named
;; here, so that both sides name them the same way and a change reaches both.

;;; Code:

(defconst yeah-acp-protocol-version 1
  "Version of the ACP protocol Yeah speaks.")

(defconst yeah-acp-queue-events-key "yeah.queueEvents"
  "Key in the `_meta' of the client capabilities that asks for Yeah's queue
events.  The queue events are not part of ACP: a client that does not know
them refuses the whole update, so they travel only to a client that asked
for them.")

(defconst yeah-acp-queue-events-capability
  (intern (concat ":" yeah-acp-queue-events-key))
  "The key of the announcement of the queue events, as Emacs reads it.
Emacs parses a JSON object into a property list whose keys are keywords,
so the key of the announcement is this keyword and not the plain symbol of
the same name.")

(defun yeah-acp-queue-events-capabilities ()
  "Return the capabilities a client announces to understand Yeah's queue events.
The announcement travels in the `_meta' of the capabilities of the client:
the queue events are not ACP, so a client that does not ask for them never
sees them.  The editor of Yeah announces them and sees the queue of the
session; a client that announces nothing is served plain ACP."
  (list :_meta (list yeah-acp-queue-events-capability t)))

(defun yeah-acp--route-response (message)
  "Route a client RESPONSE (a message with an id and no method) to the
permission it answers.  Return non-nil when it was a response."
  (let ((id (plist-get message :id)))
    (when (and id (null (plist-get message :method)))
      (when-let ((question (gethash id yeah-acp--pending-permissions)))
        (remhash id yeah-acp--pending-permissions)
        (let ((decision (yeah-acp--permission-decision message)))
          (when (yeah-approval-always-p decision)
            (yeah-acp--remember-decision question decision))
          (when-let ((turn (yeah-acp--turn-waiting-for
                            (plist-get question :session-id) id)))
            (yeah-turn-resume-permission turn id decision)))
        t))))

(defun yeah-acp--connection-closed (connection)
  "Cancel the work CONNECTION started and forget its pending questions.
A permission request whose asker is gone must never hang the run: the
turn is cancelled with the reason in the journal, and the request ids
of the dead connection are dropped."
  (let ((sessions nil))
    (maphash
     (lambda (id state)
       (when (eq connection (plist-get state :connection))
         (push id sessions)))
     yeah-acp--sessions)
    (let ((stale nil))
      (maphash (lambda (id question)
                 (when (memq (plist-get question :session-id) sessions)
                   (push id stale)))
               yeah-acp--pending-permissions)
      (dolist (id stale)
        (remhash id yeah-acp--pending-permissions)))
    (dolist (session-id sessions)
      (let* ((state (yeah-acp--session-state session-id))
             (control (and state (plist-get state :control))))
        (when control
          (yeah-control-cancel control "the client disconnected"))))))

(defun yeah-acp--dispatch (method params id)
  "Dispatch ACP METHOD with PARAMS and request ID.
Return a response string for immediate requests, or nil for notifications
and asynchronously answered prompts."
  (pcase method
    ("initialize"
     (yeah-acp--response id (yeah-acp-initialize params)))
    ("session/new"
     (yeah-acp--response id (yeah-acp-session-new params)))
    ("session/load"
     (yeah-acp--response id (yeah-acp-session-load params)))
    ("session/prompt"
     (yeah-acp-session-prompt params id))
    ("session/cancel"
     (yeah-acp-session-cancel params))
    ("session/steer"
     (yeah-acp--response id (yeah-acp-session-steer params)))
    ("session/withdraw"
     (yeah-acp--response id (yeah-acp-session-withdraw params)))
    ("session/recover"
     (yeah-acp--response id (yeah-acp-session-recover params)))
    (_
     (yeah-acp--error id -32601 (format "Method not found: %s" method)))))

(defun yeah-acp-handle-message (json-string)
  "Handle one JSON-RPC message string and return a response string or nil."
  (condition-case nil
      (let* ((parsed (json-parse-string json-string :object-type 'plist
                                        :array-type 'list))
             (method (plist-get parsed :method))
             (id (plist-get parsed :id))
             (params (or (plist-get parsed :params) '())))
        (if (null method)
            (when (yeah-acp--route-response parsed)
              nil)
          (condition-case err
              (yeah-acp--dispatch method params id)
            (user-error
             (yeah-acp--error id -32602 (error-message-string err))))))
    (error
     (yeah-acp--error nil -32700 "Parse error"))))

(defun yeah-acp--read-line ()
  "Read one line from standard input, or nil at end of file."
  (yeah-wire-read-line))

(defun yeah-acp--live-turns ()
  "Return the turns that run now, one per session at most.
The turn of a session is the one its controller runs: the wire drives the
sessions through their controllers, so the controllers know what runs."
  (let (turns)
    (maphash
     (lambda (_id state)
       (let ((control (plist-get state :control)))
         (when-let ((turn (and control (yeah-control-active-turn control))))
           (unless (yeah-turn-done turn)
             (push turn turns)))))
     yeah-acp--sessions)
    turns))

;;;###autoload
(defun yeah-acp-serve (&optional transport answerer output-function)
  "Serve ACP over standard input/output until EOF.
TRANSPORT and ANSWERER configure the agent for this service process.
OUTPUT-FUNCTION receives serialized JSON messages and defaults to stdout.
After each request the server lets the work it started settle, so an
asynchronous prompt answer leaves before the next request is read.
A cancellation that arrives while a prompt runs is therefore read only
after that prompt settled; `yeah-acp-serve-socket' does not have this
limit."
  (setq yeah-acp--transport transport
        yeah-acp--answerer answerer
        yeah-acp--output-function (or output-function #'yeah-acp--print-line))
  (let ((yeah-acp--output yeah-acp--output-function))
    (catch 'eof
      (while t
        (let ((line (yeah-acp--read-line)))
          (unless line
            (throw 'eof nil))
          (unless (string-blank-p line)
            (let ((response (yeah-acp-handle-message line)))
              (when response
                (funcall yeah-acp--output-function response)))
            (yeah-wire-pump-until
             (lambda () (null (yeah-acp--live-turns)))))))))
  nil)

;;;###autoload
(defun yeah-acp-serve-socket (service &optional transport answerer family)
  "Serve ACP on the local socket SERVICE until the server stops.
TRANSPORT and ANSWERER configure the agent for this service process.
FAMILY is `local' for a Unix socket and `ipv4' for a loopback TCP port.
The connection is a process, so the event loop keeps running while the
server waits: a `session/cancel' that arrives during a running prompt is
handled while that prompt is still running, and two connections are
served at the same time."
  (setq yeah-acp--transport transport
        yeah-acp--answerer answerer)
  (yeah-wire-socket-serve
   service
   (lambda (line respond &optional connection)
     (let ((yeah-acp--output respond)
           (yeah-acp--connection connection))
       (let ((response (yeah-acp-handle-message line)))
         (when response
           (funcall respond response)))))
   family
   #'yeah-acp--connection-closed))

(defun yeah-acp--reset-for-test ()
  "Clear ACP sessions, listeners and pending questions for tests."
  (maphash
   (lambda (_id state)
     (when-let ((listener (plist-get state :listener)))
       (setq yeah-events-write-functions
             (delete listener yeah-events-write-functions))))
   yeah-acp--sessions)
  (clrhash yeah-acp--sessions)
  (clrhash yeah-acp--pending-permissions)
  (clrhash yeah-acp--client-capabilities)
  (setq yeah-acp--counter 0))

(provide 'yeah-acp)
;;; yeah-acp.el ends here

;;; check-acp-dispatcher-routes-every-method.el --- canary for the ACP wire -*- lexical-binding: t; no-byte-compile: t -*-
;;
;; Copyright (C) 2026  Petr Kosov
;;
;; This file is part of Yeah.
;;
;; Yeah is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
;; it under the terms of the Apache License, Version 2.0.

;;; Commentary:
;;
;; The ERT suite calls the handlers directly; this check drives the JSON-RPC
;; dispatcher itself for every method of the v1 surface -- initialize,
;; session/new, session/load, session/prompt and session/cancel -- and asks
;; it to refuse a method it does not know and a request it cannot accept.
;; A dispatcher that answers an unknown method is worse than one that says
;; nothing: the client cannot tell a refusal from a result.
;;
;; The prompt route is asynchronous by contract: the dispatcher returns
;; nothing for it and the answer leaves later, carrying a stop reason.
;;
;; Exit codes: 0 -- the dispatcher routes and refuses correctly; 1 -- it does not.

;;; Code:

(require 'cl-lib)
(require 'yeah-acp)

(defvar yeah-check--emitted nil
  "Messages the ACP dispatcher emitted during the check.")

(defun yeah-check--parse (text)
  "Parse TEXT as a JSON object with plist and list types."
  (json-parse-string text :object-type 'plist :array-type 'list))

(defun yeah-check--response (method params)
  "Return the parsed JSON-RPC response for METHOD with PARAMS, or nil."
  (let* ((request (format "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":1,\"method\":\"%s\",\"params\":%s}"
                           method params))
         (raw (yeah-acp-handle-message request)))
    (and raw (yeah-check--parse raw))))

(defun yeah-check--result (method params)
  "Return the result object of the response for METHOD with PARAMS."
  (plist-get (yeah-check--response method params) :result))

(defun yeah-check--answer-for (id)
  "Return the parsed message answering request ID, or nil."
  (let ((text (cl-find-if (lambda (line)
                            (equal id (plist-get (yeah-check--parse line) :id)))
                          yeah-check--emitted)))
    (and text (yeah-check--parse text))))

(defun yeah-check--run (cwd)
  "Drive the dispatcher over CWD and return a failure message, or nil."
  (let ((failure nil))
    (let ((result (yeah-check--result "initialize" "{\"protocolVersion\":1}")))
      (unless (and result (equal 1 (plist-get result :protocolVersion)))
        (setq failure "initialize was not answered with protocol version 1")))
    (let* ((session (yeah-check--result
                     "session/new"
                     (format "{\"cwd\":\"%s\",\"mcpServers\":null}" cwd)))
           (session-id (plist-get session :sessionId)))
      (unless (stringp session-id)
        (setq failure "session/new was not answered with a session id"))
      (let ((loaded (yeah-check--result
                     "session/load"
                     (format "{\"cwd\":\"%s\",\"sessionId\":\"%s\"}"
                             cwd session-id))))
        (unless loaded
          (setq failure "session/load was not answered")))
      (setq yeah-check--emitted nil)
      (let ((raw (yeah-acp-handle-message
                  (json-serialize
                   (list :jsonrpc "2.0"
                         :id 2
                         :method "session/prompt"
                         :params (list :sessionId session-id
                                       :prompt (vector (list :type "text"
                                                             :text "hi"))))))))
        (unless (null raw)
          (setq failure "session/prompt answered before the turn reached a terminal state")))
      (let* ((answer (yeah-check--answer-for 2))
             (stop (plist-get (plist-get answer :result) :stopReason)))
        (unless (equal "end_turn" stop)
          (setq failure
                (format "session/prompt was not answered with the end_turn stop reason: %S in %S"
                        stop yeah-check--emitted))))
      (let ((raw (yeah-acp-handle-message
                  (json-serialize
                   (list :jsonrpc "2.0"
                         :method "session/cancel"
                         :params (list :sessionId session-id))))))
        (unless (null raw)
          (setq failure (format "session/cancel answered a notification: %S" raw))))
      (let ((unknown (yeah-check--response "session/unknown" "{}")))
        (unless (and (plist-member unknown :error)
                     (= -32601 (plist-get (plist-get unknown :error) :code)))
          (setq failure "an unknown method was not refused with -32601")))
      (let ((invalid (yeah-check--response "session/new" "{}")))
        (unless (and (plist-member invalid :error)
                     (= -32602 (plist-get (plist-get invalid :error) :code)))
          (setq failure "an invalid request was not refused with -32602"))))
    failure))

(let* ((home (make-temp-file "yeah-acp-check" t))
       (cwd (file-truename home))
       (failure nil)
       yeah-data-home)
  (setq yeah-data-home home)
  (unwind-protect
      (progn
        (setq yeah-check--emitted nil
              yeah-acp--output-function
              (lambda (text) (push text yeah-check--emitted))
              yeah-acp--transport
              (lambda (_prompt callback)
                (funcall callback
                         (list 'tool-call
                               (list (list :name "finish")
                                     (list "the answer")
                                     (lambda (_value) nil))))))
        (setq failure (yeah-check--run cwd)))
    (yeah-acp--reset-for-test)
    (delete-directory home t t))
  (when failure
    (message "%s" failure)
    (kill-emacs 1)))

(kill-emacs 0)

;;; check-acp-dispatcher-routes-every-method.el ends here

;;; check-wire-speaks-acp.el --- the wire of Yeah speaks ACP -*- lexical-binding: t; no-byte-compile: t -*-
;;
;; Copyright (C) 2026  Petr Kosov
;;
;; This file is part of Yeah.
;;
;; Yeah is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
;; it under the terms of the Apache License, Version 2.0.

;;; Commentary:
;;
;; A real Emacs process serves ACP on a local socket.  Two clients connect to
;; it, one after the other:
;;
;;   * the first announces nothing at `initialize'.  It must see plain ACP:
;;     every update names a kind that the ACP schema declares, the content
;;     of a chunk is one content block, and Yeah's own queue events do not
;;     reach it.
;;   * the second announces in the `_meta' of its capabilities that it
;;     understands Yeah's queue events.  The event that moves an input into
;;     the queue must reach that client.
;;
;; The model is a fake that never answers, so the prompt stays open and the
;; queue of the session can be watched.  The socket is a file in a temporary
;; directory: no network is involved.
;;
;; A second server answers at once: its model calls the `finish' tool and says
;; nothing else.  The summary of that run is the answer of the agent, and it
;; must reach the client as the message of the agent.  The call of the tool
;; must reach it too, with the arguments the tool was called with.

;;; Code:

(require 'cl-lib)
(require 'json)
(require 'yeah-acp-vocabulary)

(defvar yeah-check--position nil
  "Position in the client buffer after the last line consumed.")

(defvar yeah-check--aside nil
  "Messages read aside while waiting for another one.")

(defun yeah-check--emacs ()
  "Return the Emacs program to run the server."
  (or (and (getenv "EMACS") (file-executable-p (getenv "EMACS")) (getenv "EMACS"))
      (executable-find "emacs")
      (and (file-executable-p "/proc/self/exe") "/proc/self/exe")
      (and (file-executable-p (expand-file-name "~/.nix-profile/bin/emacs"))
           (expand-file-name "~/.nix-profile/bin/emacs"))))

(defun yeah-check--lib-directory ()
  "Return the directory holding Yeah's Elisp modules."
  (file-name-directory (or (locate-library "yeah-acp") "yeah-acp.el")))

(defun yeah-check--schema-path ()
  "Return the path of the ACP schema, or nil when it cannot be found."
  (seq-find
   (lambda (path) (file-readable-p path))
   (list (expand-file-name
          "../schemas/acp-v1.json"
          (file-name-directory (or (locate-library "yeah-acp") "yeah-acp.el")))
         (expand-file-name "schemas/acp-v1.json" default-directory))))

(defun yeah-check--acp-kinds ()
  "Return the update kinds the ACP schema declares.
The schema is the measure of the wire: a kind that is not in it is a kind
that a client which checks the wire refuses."
  (let* ((path (yeah-check--schema-path))
         (schema (when path
                   (with-temp-buffer
                     (insert-file-contents path)
                     (json-parse-string (buffer-string) :object-type 'alist
                                        :array-type 'list))))
         (definitions (cdr (assoc 'definitions schema)))
         (notification (cdr (assoc 'SessionUpdateNotification definitions)))
         (notification-properties (cdr (assoc 'properties notification)))
         (update (cdr (assoc 'update notification-properties)))
         (update-properties (cdr (assoc 'properties update)))
         (session-update (cdr (assoc 'sessionUpdate update-properties))))
    (cdr (assoc 'enum session-update))))

(defun yeah-check--start-server (data-home socket transport)
  "Start the ACP server process for DATA-HOME on SOCKET and return it.
TRANSPORT is the body of the fake transport of the server: `nil' leaves the
prompt open, and the body of a call to `finish' ends the run with the
summary of the agent."
  (make-process
   :name "yeah-acp-server"
   :command
   (list (yeah-check--emacs) "-Q" "--batch"
         "-L" (yeah-check--lib-directory)
         "-l" "yeah-acp"
         "--eval"
         (format
          (concat "(progn (setq yeah-data-home %S) "
                  "(setq yeah-input-directory %S) "
                  "(defun yeah-check--transport (prompt callback) %s) "
                  "(yeah-acp-serve-socket %S #'yeah-check--transport))")
          data-home
          (expand-file-name "pending/" data-home)
          transport
          socket))
   :connection-type 'pipe
   :noquery t
   :filter (lambda (_process _chunk) nil)))

(defun yeah-check--connect (socket)
  "Connect to the server on SOCKET and return the connection process.
The connection is retried until the server is listening."
  (let ((deadline (+ (float-time) 10))
        (connection nil))
    (while (and (null connection) (< (float-time) deadline))
      (setq connection
            (condition-case nil
                (make-network-process
                 :name "yeah-acp-client"
                 :family 'local
                 :service socket
                 :noquery t
                 :filter (lambda (_process chunk)
                           (with-current-buffer yeah-check--buffer
                             (insert chunk))))
              (file-missing nil)))
      (unless connection
        (accept-process-output nil 0.05)))
    connection))

(defvar yeah-check--buffer nil
  "The buffer collecting the messages the client received.")

(defun yeah-check--send (connection object)
  "Send OBJECT as one JSON line to CONNECTION."
  (process-send-string connection (concat (json-serialize object) "\n")))

(defun yeah-check--next-message (&optional timeout)
  "Return the next message the client received, or nil.
TIMEOUT defaults to 5 seconds."
  (let ((deadline (+ (float-time) (or timeout 5)))
        (message nil))
    (while (and (null message) (< (float-time) deadline))
      (accept-process-output nil 0.05)
      (with-current-buffer yeah-check--buffer
        (goto-char yeah-check--position)
        (when (re-search-forward "^\\(.+\\)\n" nil t)
          (setq message (json-parse-string (match-string 1)
                                          :object-type 'plist :array-type 'list))
          (setq yeah-check--position (match-end 0)))))
    message))

(defun yeah-check--await (predicate &optional timeout)
  "Return the next message that satisfies PREDICATE.
A message that does not satisfy it is kept aside and returned by
`yeah-check--collect'.  TIMEOUT defaults to 5 seconds."
  (let ((deadline (+ (float-time) (or timeout 5)))
        (message nil)
        (aside nil))
    (while (and (null message) (< (float-time) deadline))
      (let ((candidate (yeah-check--next-message 1)))
        (when candidate
          (if (funcall predicate candidate)
              (setq message candidate)
            (push candidate aside)))))
    (setq yeah-check--aside aside)
    message))

(defun yeah-check--collect (seconds)
  "Return every message the client received within SECONDS.
The messages read aside by `yeah-check--await' come first."
  (let ((deadline (+ (float-time) seconds))
        (messages (reverse yeah-check--aside)))
    (while (< (float-time) deadline)
      (let ((message (yeah-check--next-message 0.2)))
        (when message
          (push message messages))))
    (nreverse messages)))

(defun yeah-check--response (id)
  "Return a predicate matching the JSON-RPC response with ID."
  (lambda (message)
    (and (equal (plist-get message :id) id)
         (not (plist-get message :method)))))

(defun yeah-check--update (message)
  "Return the update object of MESSAGE, or nil."
  (plist-get (plist-get message :params) :update))

(defun yeah-check--update-kind (message)
  "Return the kind of the update of MESSAGE, or nil."
  (plist-get (yeah-check--update message) :sessionUpdate))

(defun yeah-check--drive (announce data-home)
  "Drive one client against the server and return what it saw.
ANNOUNCE says whether the client announces Yeah's queue events at
`initialize'.  DATA-HOME is the home of the service.  The result is a
plist with the updates the client received, the id of the input it queued
and the failures the client found."
  (let* ((connection (yeah-check--connect
                      (expand-file-name "yeah-acp.sock" data-home)))
         (params (list :protocolVersion yeah-acp-protocol-version))

# AGENTS.md — the entry point to this repository

> **Yeah** means **Yeah, Emacs Agent Harness**: a recursive acronym, the
> **Y** is the Y-combinator. The harness itself is
> Emacs Lisp; Emacs is not merely a client to an external agent. The model is
> reached through gptel, effects go through the tool registry and permission
> system, and session history is append-only JSONL.
>
> The long-term Y metaphor means bounded recursive delegation, runtime
> self-inspection and a fixed point where Yeah can develop and verify Yeah.
> These are goals, not assertions about today's prototype.
>
> This repository is governed by **math-coding v5**: `spec.json` holds the
> standing specification (`schema_version: 5`) and the claims, `waves/*.json`
> holds the historical work units, and evidence comes from checks bound by
> `mathc run`.  Version 4 is frozen and archived at `waves/spec-v4.json`;
> its evidence is not current.
> `docs/PLAN.md` defines the current target sequence; do not mistake an old
> wave number or a green module row for a working end-to-end feature.

## Read first, in this order

1. `README.md` — actual current status and explicit limitations.
2. `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — the normative target: purpose, ten decisions,
   contracts, security, placements and non-goals.
3. `docs/PLAN.md` — the detailed eight-stage execution plan and release gates.
4. `docs/ENGINEERING.md` — binding dependency, infrastructure, library,
   process, security, testing and packaging practices.
5. `spec.json` — the standing machine-checked specification.
6. `waves/*.json` — existing math-coding units, with intent, check, promise
   and objection.
7. `ELISP_BEST_PRACTICES.md` — kernel Elisp conventions; §11 is the trap log.
8. `lib/yeah-*.el` — the implementation, one feature per file.

If two sources contradict each other, report the contradiction in the open
work item. Never resolve it by silently making documentation more optimistic.

## Current warnings for every agent

- This is a kernel prototype, not a usable coding product.
- The parity with other harnesses was piloted on 2026-11-15, and the
  difference the pilot found was a defect of the turn, not a difference of
  quality: after the results of the tool calls arrive, the model may answer
  with an empty message, and the turn took that as the end of the work and
  stopped without the effect (docs/LIVE-EVIDENCE.md, "The pilot of the
  parity").  The defect is fixed (the claim
  `an-empty-answer-does-not-end-the-run'), and the pilot on the fixed turn
  moved one task of three; the nudge now carries the state of the work
  (the claim `a-silence-nudge-carries-the-state-of-the-work'), because the
  provider goes silent after every batch of tool results and the model was
  answering the nudge by starting the work over.  With that, Yeah passes
  two tasks of three and pi passes three.  The third task failed in the
  tools: the `read` of a file nobody has edited yet returns no tick, and
  the `edit` refused the tick the model guessed as stale although the file
  has not changed; wave 26 makes a guessed tick ignored rather than
  refused (the claim
  `a-guessed-tick-does-not-refuse-an-unchanged-file'), and that task of the
  pilot passes now.  The provider was overloaded for hours (HTTP 529 to both
  harnesses), so the pilot of 15:02 measured one task of three and two
  blocked runs: the runner records a run the provider stopped as **blocked**,
  neither a pass nor a failure (the claim
  `a-provider-failure-is-not-a-failure-of-the-agent').  The pilot of 15:39, on
  the code of wave 28, measured two tasks of three — Yeah passed both of them
  and pi passed all three — and the third was blocked, because the transport
  to the provider died.  The parity of that run is not measured either.  The
  pilot of 17:06, on the code of waves 30+31, measured one task of three for
  Yeah and two of three for pi: all three runs of Yeah ended `unfinished`,
  because the provider goes silent, and the one task that failed in the tools
  failed on the **version token** of the file — the model copied 58 of the 64
  characters of the digest and the edit refused the edit of a file that had
  not changed (docs/LIVE-EVIDENCE.md, "The pilot that measured the copy of the
  version token").  The pilot of 17:23, on the code of wave 32, measured two
  tasks of three for Yeah and three of three for pi: the token of the file is
  short now, the read handed out twelve characters, and the tasks the model
  worked on passed.  The task that Yeah failed failed on the provider: the
  model announced the fix ("Fixing it to use floating-point division:") and
  called no tool (docs/LIVE-EVIDENCE.md, "The pilot after the token became
  short").  The pilot of 2026-11-16 06:43–06:48, on the code of wave 33, measured
  two tasks of three for Yeah and three of three for pi, and the pilot of
  07:04, on the code of wave 34, measured one task of three for Yeah and three
  of three for pi.  Both failures were the same failure of the model and not of
  the harness: the model read the files of the task and never called the tool
  that would change them, while the guards of waves 29, 32, 33 and 34 were
  never in the way (docs/LIVE-EVIDENCE.md, "The live checks and the pilot after
  wave 34").  The pilot of 08:07, on the code of wave 35, measured two tasks of
  three for Yeah and three of three for pi, and the third task of Yeah was
  blocked: the transport to the provider died with "Curl failed with exit code
  28" after the model had read the file and computed the sum.  A run that the
  provider stops is blocked and not a failure of the agent, and it says
  nothing about either harness (docs/LIVE-EVIDENCE.md, "The live checks and the
  pilot after wave 35").  The pilot of 10:00, on the code of wave 36, measured
  two tasks of three for Yeah and three of three for pi, and the third task of
  Yeah failed in the tools: the model read the file, computed the sum with
  `bash` (the tool answered 100) and then answered with an empty message three
  times; the harness nudged three times, every nudge carrying the state of the
  work, and the run ended "unfinished" with the nudge budget spent.  The file

  the shape the provider has had for two days, and `write-new-file` passed in

  and then answered with an empty message; the harness nudged it with the
  state of the work, and the model went silent again (docs/LIVE-EVIDENCE.md,
  "The live checks and the pilot after wave 37").  The pilot of 13:12, on the
  code of wave 38, measured one task of three for Yeah and three of three for
  pi: two tasks of Yeah failed in the same shape — the model read the files,
  and then answered with an empty message three times, and the run ended
  "unfinished" with the nudge budget spent.  The row of such a run names the
  shape of it since wave 38, so the reader of the pilot sees the cause of the
  failed check and not only its verdict; the verdict of the row is still the
  verdict, because the classification of a run that did not finish is a
  decision of the owner (docs/LIVE-EVIDENCE.md, "The live checks and the
  pilot after wave 38").  The threshold of the
  parity is a decision of the owner (docs/PLAN.md §13), and nobody may quote
  the pilot as a verdict about parity.
- A decision that arrives while the tools of the previous decision are still
  running no longer breaks the run: the turn keeps the calls, runs them when
  the running batch has settled, and gives the model the results of every
  batch together (wave 28, the claims
  `a-decision-that-arrives-while-the-tools-run-does-not-break-the-run' and
  `the-same-tool-call-does-not-run-twice').  The live checks of 15:38 hold
  no transition error at all.  The live coding task still fails, and it fails
  for another reason: the model of the provider answers with an empty message
  and the run ends with the record "unfinished" — the work is not done, and
  the run says so.
- The read of a file shows the file on disk, but the tick it hands out
  belongs to the buffer that visits the file: when Emacs holds unsaved
  changes of that file, the model sees the disk and the edit applies to the
  buffer.  Wave 29 refused that case when the model presents the version of
  the read; wave 33 makes the refusal the answer of every edit, with a
  version or without one, because a read of the disk cannot show the changes
  of the person (the claim
  `an-edit-never-lands-on-a-file-with-unsaved-changes').  The write takes the
  same short version token and is refused when the file changed after the
  read that handed it out (the claim
  `a-write-never-lands-on-a-file-that-changed'); the token of the write is
  optional, so a model that presents no version writes without that guard.
  A write of a file that Emacs holds unsaved changes of is not refused: the
  write goes to the disk and the buffer becomes stale — that is open in
  docs/PLAN-NEXT.md.
- The harness opens the files of the project on behalf of the model, and
  Emacs runs the local variables of a file and the directory-local variables
  of its directory when it opens one.  That code is the code of the project,
  and the project is untrusted input: a `mode:` entry names a function that
  Emacs calls, and an `eval:` entry is Elisp that Emacs evaluates.  The edit
  opens the file through `yeah-untrusted-open-file` (lib/yeah-untrusted.el),
  where that machinery is neutralized whatever the configuration of the

  `an-edit-never-runs-the-local-variables-of-the-project').  The price is
  named: the mode line of the file is part of its content, so it is ignored,

- Every read now hands the model the version of the file as well: the digest
  of its bytes (lib/yeah-version.el). The edit checks that version and is

- The process of the ACP server outlives the agent when the client keeps its

- The checks read the journals through one reader

- Stage 7 is implemented offline: an agent preset is a file (a Markdown or

проводу с клиентом, который отвечает на разрешения.

Чего не хватает — не «интеграция вообще», а пять конкретных вещей:

1. **Рабочий каталог сессии не применяется к инструментам.** Paseo передаёт
   `cwd` в `session/new`, Yeah его записывает в журнал — и больше нигде не
   использует. Инструменты (`read`, `edit`, `write`, `bash`) считают
   относительные пути от `default-directory` процесса Emacs, а не от
   каталога рабочей области. Это ломает всё, что делает агент в репозитории.
   **(живой прогон: подтверждено — относительный путь ушёл в рабочий
   каталог сервиса, а не в `cwd` сессии; §2.9)**
2. **Нет `session/set_mode`.** Переключатель режимов (Plan/Build) в UI Paseo
   не появится: ACP-метода нет, `-32601`.
3. **Отмена не вытесняет идущий промпт на stdio.** `session/cancel`
   читается только после того, как промпт завершился. Долгий ход модели
   нельзя прервать — а значит, нельзя и перебить агента. (На сокете отмена
   вытесняет; канарь `check-wire-cancel-preempts.el` перезапущен и зелёный.)
4. **Бэкенд модели не внедряется через окружение.** В `lib/` нет ни одной
   переменной `YEAH_*`; ключ и модель провайдера надо передавать через
   `--eval` или `yeah-service-init-file`, а у Paseo `command` — это
   фиксированный argv.
5. **Маршрут ACP по умолчанию выдаёт ложный успех.** Надзор за прогоном
   (`max-nudges`) по умолчанию равен нулю, поэтому модель, которая вместо
   действия описывает намерение («I'll create that file now.»), завершает
   прогон как `completed`, и клиент получает `stopReason: "end_turn"` —
   неотличимый от успеха. Ничего не сделано, разрешение не спросили,
   журнал не отличается от журнала удачного прогона. **(живой прогон:
   воспроизведено и исправлено включением надзора; §2.9)**

;;; check-wire-speaks-over-stdio.el --- real ACP and MCP servers over stdio -*- lexical-binding: t; no-byte-compile: t -*-
;;
;; Copyright (C) 2026  Petr Kosov

;;; Commentary:
;;
;; Start real Emacs processes serving ACP and MCP on stdio, exchange JSON-RPC
;; lines with them and read the answers back.  No network is involved.

;;; Code:

(require 'cl-lib)
(require 'json)

(defvar-local yeah-check--position nil
  "Position in the server output buffer after the last line consumed.")

(defun yeah-check--emacs ()
  "Return the Emacs program to run the servers."
  (or (and (getenv "EMACS") (file-executable-p (getenv "EMACS")) (getenv "EMACS"))
      (executable-find "emacs")
      (expand-file-name "~/.nix-profile/bin/emacs")))

(defun yeah-check--lib-directory ()
  "Return the directory holding Yeah's Elisp modules."
  (file-name-directory (or (locate-library "yeah-mcp") "yeah-mcp.el")))

(defun yeah-check--start-server (feature expression)
  "Start a server process serving FEATURE with EXPRESSION.
Return the process and the buffer holding its output."
  (let ((buffer (generate-new-buffer "*yeah-wire-test*")))
    (with-current-buffer buffer
      (setq-local yeah-check--position (point-min)))
    (list (make-process
           :name "yeah-wire-test"
           :buffer buffer
           :command (list (yeah-check--emacs) "-Q" "--batch"
                          "-L" (yeah-check--lib-directory)
                          "-l" feature "--eval" expression)
           :connection-type 'pipe
           :noquery t
           :filter (lambda (_process chunk)
                     (with-current-buffer buffer
                       (insert chunk))))
          buffer)))

(defun yeah-check--send (process object)
  "Send OBJECT as one JSON line to PROCESS."
  (process-send-string process (concat (json-serialize object) "\n")))

(defun yeah-check--await-line (buffer &optional timeout)
  "Return the next complete JSON line in BUFFER, waiting at most TIMEOUT."
  (let ((deadline (+ (float-time) (or timeout 5)))
        (line nil))
    (while (and (null line) (< (float-time) deadline))
      (accept-process-output nil 0.05)
      (with-current-buffer buffer
        (goto-char yeah-check--position)
        (when (re-search-forward "^\\(.+\\)\n" nil t)
          (setq line (match-string 1))
          (setq yeah-check--position (match-end 0)))))
    (and line (json-parse-string line :object-type 'plist :array-type 'list))))

(let ((failures nil)
      (data-home (make-temp-file "yeah-wire-data" t)))
  (unwind-protect
      (progn
        ;; --- MCP over stdio ---
        (let* ((started (yeah-check--start-server
                         "yeah-mcp"
                         (format "(progn (setq yeah-data-home %S) (yeah-mcp-serve))"
                                 data-home)))
               (process (nth 0 started))
               (buffer (nth 1 started)))
          (yeah-check--send
           process
           (list :jsonrpc "2.0" :id 1 :method "initialize"
                 :params (list :protocolVersion "2025-06-18")))
          (let ((response (yeah-check--await-line buffer)))
            (unless (equal "2025-06-18"
                           (plist-get (plist-get response :result)
                                      :protocolVersion))
              (push (format "MCP initialize did not answer: %S" response)
                    failures)))
          (yeah-check--send process (list :jsonrpc "2.0" :id 2 :method "tools/list"))
          (let ((response (yeah-check--await-line buffer)))
            (let ((tools (plist-get (plist-get response :result) :tools)))
              (unless (and (listp tools)
                           (cl-some (lambda (tool)
                                       (equal "emacs__buffer_list"
                                              (plist-get tool :name)))
                                     tools))
                (push (format "MCP tools/list did not publish the tools: %S"
                              response)
                      failures))))
          (when (process-live-p process)
            (delete-process process)))

        ;; --- ACP over stdio ---
        (let* ((started (yeah-check--start-server
                         "yeah-acp"
                         (format "(progn (setq yeah-data-home %S) (yeah-acp-serve))"
                                 data-home)))
               (process (nth 0 started))
               (buffer (nth 1 started)))
          (yeah-check--send
           process
           (list :jsonrpc "2.0" :id 1 :method "initialize"
                 :params (list :protocolVersion 1)))
          (let ((response (yeah-check--await-line buffer)))
            (unless (equal 1 (plist-get (plist-get response :result)
                                        :protocolVersion))
              (push (format "ACP initialize did not answer: %S" response)
                    failures)))
          (yeah-check--send
           process
           (list :jsonrpc "2.0" :id 2 :method "session/new"
                 :params (list :cwd data-home :mcpServers nil)))
          (let ((response (yeah-check--await-line buffer)))
            (unless (stringp (plist-get (plist-get response :result) :sessionId))
              (push (format "ACP session/new did not answer: %S" response)
                    failures)))
          (when (process-live-p process)
            (delete-process process))))

    (dolist (failure failures)
      (message "wire: %s" failure))
    (ignore-errors (delete-directory data-home t))
    (if failures
        (kill-emacs 1)
      (kill-emacs 0))))

;;; check-wire-speaks-over-stdio.el ends here

;;; measure-server2.el --- measure the CPU of an ACP server with pending output -*- lexical-binding: t -*-
(require 'cl-lib)
(require 'json)

(defvar meas--emacs
  (or (and (getenv \"EMACS\") (file-executable-p (getenv \"EMACS\")) (getenv \"EMACS\"))
      (executable-find \"emacs\")))
(defvar meas--lib (file-name-directory (or (locate-library \"yeah-acp\") (expand-file-name \"lib/yeah-acp.el\" default-directory))))
(defvar meas--buffer (generate-new-buffer \"*meas*\"))
(defvar meas--pos (point-min))

(setq meas--process
      (make-process
       :name \"yeah-meas\"
       :buffer meas--buffer
       :command (list meas--emacs \"-Q\" \"--batch\"
                      \"-L\" meas--lib
                      \"-l\" \"yeah-acp\" \"--eval\"
                      (concat \"(progn \"
                              \"(defun yeah-check--transport (prompt callback) nil) \"
                              ;; a child that writes without end: the provider streams
                              \"(make-process :name \\\"noise\\\" :command '(\\\"sh\\\" \\\"-c\\\" \\\"while true; do echo 0123456789012345678901234567890123456789; done\\\") :noquery t :filter (lambda (_p _c) nil)) \"
                              \"(yeah-acp-serve #'yeah-check--transport))\"))
       :connection-type 'pipe
       :noquery t
       :filter (lambda (_p chunk) (with-current-buffer meas--buffer (insert chunk)))))

(defun meas--send (object)
  (process-send-string meas--process (concat (json-serialize object) \"\\n\")))

(defun meas--await-line (&optional timeout)
  (let ((deadline (+ (float-time) (or timeout 10)))
        (line nil))
    (while (and (null line) (< (float-time) deadline))
      (accept-process-output nil 0.05)
      (with-current-buffer meas--buffer
        (goto-char meas--pos)
        (when (re-search-forward \"^\\\\(.+\\\\)\\n\" nil t)
          (setq line (match-string 1))
          (setq meas--pos (match-end 0)))))
    line))

(defun meas--ticks (pid)
  (let ((stat (with-temp-buffer
                (insert-file-contents (format \"/proc/%d/stat\" pid))
                (goto-char (point-min))
                (buffer-string))))
    (let* ((rest (substring stat (1+ (string-match \") \" stat))))
           (fields (split-string rest \" \")))
      (+ (string-to-number (nth 11 fields))
         (string-to-number (nth 12 fields))))))

(meas--send (list :jsonrpc \"2.0\" :id 1 :method \"initialize\" :params (list :protocolVersion 1)))
(message \"init: %s\" (meas--await-line))
(meas--send (list :jsonrpc \"2.0\" :id 2 :method \"session/new\"
                   :params (list :cwd (file-name-as-directory default-directory) :mcpServers nil)))
(let ((line (meas--await-line)))
  (message \"session: %s\" line)
  (let* ((parsed (json-parse-string line :object-type 'plist :array-type 'list))
         (session-id (plist-get (plist-get parsed :result) :sessionId)))
    (meas--send (list :jsonrpc \"2.0\" :id 3 :method \"session/prompt\"
                       :params (list :sessionId session-id
                                      :prompt (vector (list :type \"text\" :text \"hello\")))))))

(let* ((pid (process-id meas--process))
       (before (meas--ticks pid))
       (start (float-time))
       (deadline (+ start 10)))
  (while (< (float-time) deadline)
    (accept-process-output nil 0.1))
  (let* ((after (meas--ticks pid))
         (elapsed (- (float-time) start)))
    (message \"MEASURE pid=%d ticks=%d before=%d after=%d elapsed=%.2f percent=%.2f%%\"
             pid (- after before) before after elapsed
             (* 100.0 (/ (- after before) (* (float-time) elapsed) 100.0)))))
(kill-emacs 0)
EOF
